routes.title: Unit 4A: Sequences and Infinite Series
routes.description: Learn sequences, numerical series, convergence tests, and certified error estimates through visual reasoning, rigorous bridges, worked examples, and practice.
routes.sectionTitle: Orientation and the convergence roadmap

routes.title: Sequences as Functions on the Integers
routes.description: Treat a sequence as a function on integer inputs, read sequence notation, graph discrete terms, and distinguish the terms from a continuous guide curve.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

breadcrumbs.name: Sequences as Functions on the Integers

searchTerms: sequences as functions on the integers
Sequences as Functions on the Integers

routes.title: Explicit and Recursive Sequences
routes.description: Translate between explicit and recursive sequence rules, identify initial conditions, and analyze how step-by-step definitions generate long-term behavior.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

routes.title: Limits of Sequences
routes.description: Understand sequence convergence numerically, graphically, and through the epsilon-N definition, with complete proofs and common failure patterns.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

routes.title: Limit Laws for Sequences
routes.description: Apply sequence limit laws safely, check denominators and domains, and understand how algebraic operations preserve eventual behavior.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

routes.title: The Squeeze Theorem for Sequences
routes.description: Prove limits of bounded oscillating sequences with shrinking envelopes and the sequence form of the Squeeze Theorem.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

routes.title: Monotone and Bounded Sequences
routes.description: Use monotonicity, bounds, induction, and the Monotone Convergence Theorem to analyze recursively defined sequences before solving for a limit.
routes.sectionTitle: Sequences and their limits

routes.title: Infinite Series and Partial Sums
routes.description: Define an infinite series through its partial sums and distinguish term behavior from convergence of the running total.
routes.sectionTitle: Infinite series and foundational examples

routes.title: Geometric Series
routes.description: Derive and use finite and infinite geometric-sum formulas, handle shifted indices, repeating decimals, and convergence conditions.
routes.sectionTitle: Infinite series and foundational examples

routes.title: Telescoping Series
routes.description: Expose cancellation through finite partial sums, track surviving boundary terms, and evaluate one-step and shifted telescoping series.
routes.sectionTitle: Infinite series and foundational examples

routes.title: The nth-Term Test for Divergence
routes.description: Use the nth-term test correctly as a one-way divergence test and understand why terms approaching zero do not guarantee convergence.
routes.sectionTitle: Infinite series and foundational examples

routes.title: The Harmonic Series and p-Series
routes.description: Understand harmonic divergence, the p-series threshold, grouping arguments, and how slowly shrinking terms can still accumulate without bound.
routes.sectionTitle: Infinite series and foundational examples

routes.title: The Integral Test
routes.description: Connect positive decreasing series with improper integrals, verify every hypothesis, and use rectangle inequalities to justify the Integral Test.
routes.sectionTitle: Positive-series tests and error estimates

routes.title: Integral-Test Remainder Estimates
routes.description: Bound series tails with improper integrals and convert a requested accuracy into a sufficient number of terms.
routes.sectionTitle: Positive-series tests and error estimates

routes.title: The Direct Comparison Test
routes.description: Choose comparison inequalities in the useful direction and prove convergence or divergence with familiar benchmark series.
routes.sectionTitle: Positive-series tests and error estimates

routes.title: The Limit Comparison Test
routes.description: Identify dominant term scale, choose an effective benchmark, and use a positive finite ratio limit to transfer convergence behavior.
routes.sectionTitle: Positive-series tests and error estimates

routes.title: Alternating Series
routes.description: Use decreasing magnitudes and a zero term limit to prove convergence through shrinking odd-even partial-sum brackets.
routes.sectionTitle: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests
searchTerms: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests

routes.title: Alternating-Series Error Estimates
routes.description: Certify alternating-series approximations with the first omitted term and solve for the smallest number of terms meeting a tolerance.
routes.sectionTitle: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests
searchTerms: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests

routes.title: Absolute and Conditional Convergence
routes.description: Distinguish absolute, conditional, and divergent series by testing magnitude separately from sign cancellation.
routes.sectionTitle: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests
searchTerms: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests

routes.title: The Ratio Test
routes.description: Detect geometric decay in factorial and exponential series, prove the Ratio Test mechanism, and recognize the inconclusive boundary case.
routes.sectionTitle: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests
searchTerms: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests

routes.title: The Root Test
routes.description: Extract the exponential base hidden in nth powers, apply the Root Test, and interpret limits below, above, or equal to one.
routes.sectionTitle: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests
searchTerms: Alternating, absolute, ratio, and root tests

routes.title: Choosing a Convergence Test
routes.description: Choose convergence tests from structural clues, classify conclusions precisely, and avoid wasting work on tests that cannot decide the series.
routes.sectionTitle: Test selection and the Cauchy tail idea
searchTerms: Test selection and the Cauchy tail idea

routes.title: Why Convergence Is About Tails: A Cauchy Preview
routes.description: Understand convergence through small late tails, state the Cauchy criterion with correct quantifiers, and connect it to completeness of the real numbers.
routes.sectionTitle: Test selection and the Cauchy tail idea
